policyReason: Leashed pets are permitted in the park and preserve, though the park urges leaving them home.

excerpts.quote: Leashed pets are permitted in the park and preserve.

dogRules.text: Pets must be leashed at all times; bury scat in a 6-inch cathole or pack it out.
Wolves, foxes and coyotes will kill loose dogs, especially in denning season.
Kennels in Anchorage, Soldotna, Kenai, Kasilof, Homer and Anchor Point can board dogs.
